players.product: Vertically integrated SiC substrates, epitaxy and power chips (Hunan Sanan 6-inch and 8-inch SiC lines, GaN-on-Si); 8-inch SiC substrates from Chongqing Sanan for the Anyifa 8-inch SiC epitaxy and chip joint venture

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Huang Zhijun (H1 2026 results briefing): the Anyifa joint venture (SiC epitaxy and chips sold exclusively to STMicroelectronics) had H1 2026 revenue of RMB 7,898.35 ten-thousand and net profit of RMB 3,751.20 ten-thousand. Chairman Lin Zhiqiang said the integrated-circuit segment's overall utilization was low in H1, and that in Micro LED optical interconnect the company is working with several domestic and overseas customers through multiple validation rounds to keep raising transmission speed.
